description.en: Sends a message when the power of a washing machine stays below a threshold for a set time after it was running. The message goes to the log and, if chosen, into a state, for example telegram.0.communicate.response.
description.de: Meldet, wenn die Leistung einer Waschmaschine nach dem Waschen für eine eingestellte Zeit unter einer Schwelle bleibt. Die Nachricht steht im Log und auf Wunsch in einem Datenpunkt, zum Beispiel telegram.0.communicate.response.

author: GermanBluefox

title.en: Done after below the threshold for
title.de: Fertig nach unter der Schwelle für

description.en: A state that sends what is written to it, for example telegram.0.communicate.response.
description.de: Ein Datenpunkt, der versendet, was hineingeschrieben wird, zum Beispiel telegram.0.communicate.response.

blockly:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <variables>
    <variable id="running">running</variable>
    <variable type="timeout" id="doneTimer">doneTimer</variable>
  </variables>
  <block type="on" x="10" y="10">
    <field name="OID">{{power}}</field>
    <field name="CONDITION">ne</field>
    <field name="ACK_CONDITION"></field>
    <statement name="STATEMENT">
      <block type="controls_if">
        <mutation elseif="1"></mutation>
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="logic_compare">
            <field name="OP">GT</field>
            <value name="A">
              <block type="on_source">
                <field name="ATTR">state.val</field>
              </block>
            </value>
            <value name="B">
              <block type="math_number">
                <field name="NUM">{{threshold}}</field>
              </block>
            </value>
          </block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="variables_set">
            <field name="VAR" id="running">running</field>
            <value name="VALUE">
              <block type="logic_boolean">
                <field name="BOOL">TRUE</field>
              </block>
            </value>
            <next>
              <block type="timeouts_cleartimeout">
                <field name="NAME">doneTimer</field>
              </block>
            </next>
          </block>
        </statement>
        <value name="IF1">
          <block type="logic_operation">
            <field name="OP">AND</field>
            <value name="A">
              <block type="variables_get">
                <field name="VAR" id="running">running</field>
              </block>
            </value>
            <value name="B">
              <block type="logic_compare">
                <field name="OP">EQ</field>
                <value name="A">
                  <block type="timeouts_gettimeout">
                    <field name="NAME">doneTimer</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
                <value name="B">
                  <block type="logic_null"></block>
                </value>
              </block>
            </value>
          </block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO1">
          <block type="timeouts_settimeout">
            <field name="NAME">doneTimer</field>
            <field name="DELAY">{{duration}}</field>
            <field name="UNIT">sec</field>
            <statement name="STATEMENT">
              <block type="variables_set">
                <field name="VAR" id="running">running</field>
                <value name="VALUE">
                  <block type="logic_boolean">
                    <field name="BOOL">FALSE</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
                <next>
                  <block type="debug">
                    <field name="Severity">warn</field>
                    <value name="TEXT">
                      <block type="text">
                        <field name="TEXT">{{message}}</field>
                      </block>
                    </value>
{{#if notifyState}}
                    <next>
                      <block type="control">
                        <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
                        <field name="OID">{{notifyState}}</field>
                        <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
                        <value name="VALUE">
                          <block type="text">
                            <field name="TEXT">{{message}}</field>
                          </block>
                        </value>
                      </block>
                    </next>
{{/if}}
                  </block>
                </next>
              </block>
            </statement>
          </block>
        </statement>
      </block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>
